gen-dm-serif-display-fs-epilogue: Heavy downstrokes with barely-there upstrokes give DM Serif Display its dignified bite. Epilogue sits beneath in curvy, wire-thin sans-serif strokes, its tall lowercase loosening the page up.
gen-dm-serif-display-fs-fira-sans: DM Serif Display pairs heavy stems with delicate hairlines, which looks authoritative. Fira Sans runs one stroke width through every letter, and if the heading shrinks small, those hairlines start to vanish beside it.
gen-dm-serif-display-fs-merriweather-san: DM Serif Display is all broad, dark verticals and faint hairline horizontals. Merriweather Sans brings a taller, sturdier lowercase beneath it, so the heading feels dressed up while the text feels broad-shouldered.
gen-dm-serif-display-fs-plein: Dignified from the first word, DM Serif Display shows a pronounced swing between thick and hairline strokes in every glyph. And Plein answers in low-contrast sans, with a clear channel leading into each round letter.
gen-dm-serif-display-fs-spline-sans: DM Serif Display splits sharply between fat and fine strokes, giving every heading a formal, authoritative edge on the page. Spline Sans, a plain sans of pencil-like lines, is the foil.
gen-dm-serif-display-fs-supreme: Supreme runs a thick, heavy-looking strip of crisp plain sans through the middle of the line, with letters held open. But DM Serif Display above it keeps ink-black strokes and gossamer hairlines inside single letters.
gen-dm-serif-display-general-sans: DM Serif Display sparkles where fat strokes meet hairlines. General Sans follows in plain sans strokes that look cut from wire, with an x-height filling the line and smooth bends that keep long reading easy going.
gen-dm-serif-display-gf-orbit: Authoritative in manner, DM Serif Display packs thick diagonals against hairline counter-strokes. But Orbit is plain sans bent like rope or tubing, each character floating apart, and that stark difference is the draw.
gen-dm-serif-display-manrope: Sharp serif up top, soft sans-serif below. Manrope keeps one pen width throughout, with bright open mouths on its curves and barely any step from capital to lowercase, so a long page reads smoothly under DM Serif Display.
gen-dm-serif-display-outfit: Bold stems paired with razor-thin horizontals are what make DM Serif Display so unmistakably dignified in a heading. Outfit does the opposite job best: cable-like sans curves of a single width.
